title: Design System: ALLO Book Collection UI

components.name: Book Primary Button
components.description: Primary action inside dex or inventory book pages.
components.css: .ds-book-primary { background: #E5BC65; color: #493D2D; height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #C4AA7A; font: 21px 'Do Hyeon', sans-serif; } .ds-book-primary:hover, .ds-book-primary:focus-visible { background: #F7E5B9; outline: 2px solid #C69137; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-book-primary:active { background: #D9BB7D; }

components.name: Book Secondary Button
components.description: Standard action inside dex or inventory book pages.
components.css: .ds-book-secondary { background: #EDDBB7; color: #493D2D; height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #C4AA7A; font: 21px 'Do Hyeon', sans-serif; } .ds-book-secondary:hover, .ds-book-secondary:focus-visible { background: #F7E5B9; outline: 2px solid #C69137; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-book-secondary:active { background: #D9BB7D; }

components.name: Selected Collection Slot
components.description: Selected character or item slot with visible quantity when applicable.
components.css: .ds-book-slot { position: relative; background: #E8CD8D; color: #493D2D; border: 2px solid #C69137; padding: 7px; min-width: 100px; font: 21px 'Do Hyeon', sans-serif; } .ds-book-slot:hover, .ds-book-slot:focus-visible { background: #F7E5B9; outline: 2px solid #C69137; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-book-slot-art { display: block; height: 84px; } .ds-book-slot-caption { display: block; } .ds-book-slot-count { position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 5px; font-size: 18px; }

narrative.overview: The dex and inventory are browsed as one warm, illustrated field guide. Paper, a visible spine and page layers give the collection a physical book frame; the UI remains a compact game interface inside it. This scope covers only the Unity phone dex, inventory and their shared book navigation. It does not prescribe the home, camp, cabin or other routes.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, brown ink and restrained gold selection
dos: Do keep dex and inventory content within the open-book page bounds and preserve the center spine gap.
Do keep quantity badges legible and selection visible through both fill and outline.
Do use the explicit ‘그림 준비 중’ fallback when portrait art is unavailable.
donts: Don't apply this book treatment to other app routes; this system is scoped to dex and inventory.
Don't replace ALLO collection data or introduce content from the reference game images.
Don't present missing character art as finished portrait artwork; the current upstream set contains only 6 of 12 character images.
